content_sections.heading: NAM Wayanad Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

rows.details: Pharmacist (Ayurveda), Therapist (Ayurveda), Lab Technician, Physiotherapist, Psychologist and other posts
Not exceed 40 years as on 18.11.2026 (Yoga Instructor: not exceed 50 years as on 18.11.2026)

content_sections.heading: About NAM Wayanad
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the District Programme Manager (DPM), National Ayush Mission, Wayanad District, located at District Homoeo Hospital, Anjukunnu P O, Mananthavady, Wayanad-670645. It is signed by Dr. K.G. Renjith CMO, District Programme Manager, National Ayush Mission, DPM & SU, Wayanad, and carries the seal of the District Ayush Health Society, Wayanad. Through this notice, the mission is making temporary contract appointments to posts for the Indian Systems of Medicine department and the Homoeopathy department.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 11 posts and marks the vacancy for every post as "Anticipatory". It does not print a number of posts. The salary column gives the amount exactly as printed. The notice does not state the pay period, allowances or any category-wise reservation.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: I. a) MSc Clinical Psychology / any other equivalent qualification from a UGC-recognized University / Institute owned by Government of Kerala / National Institutes of Government of India, OR b) MA / MSc in Psychology / any other equivalent qualification from a UGC-recognized University / Institute owned by Government of Kerala / National Institutes of Government of India. II. M.Phil in Clinical Psychology / any other equivalent 2-year course from an RCI-approved University / College / Institution owned by Government of Kerala / National Institutes of Government of India / UGC-recognized University. III. Rehabilitation Council of India Registration as "Clinical Psychologist." The notice lists these qualifications as alternatives, separated by "/": BNYS (Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences)/BAMS/M.Sc (Yoga)/M.Phil (Yoga)/Post Graduate Diploma in Yoga (Minimum one year duration) from a recognized University Approved Certificate Course in Yoga (One year duration) from a recognized University or Government Department Diploma in Yoga Teacher Training by SRC/YCB (Yoga Certification Board) Certificate Diploma in Yogic Science and Sports Yoga conducted by SCOLE Kerala Certificate Course in Yoga (One year duration) Applicants who hold an equivalent qualification must produce an equivalency certificate. For all posts except Yoga Instructor, the age must not exceed 40 years as on 18.11.2026. For Yoga Instructor, the revised notification dated 21.11.2026 sets the age limit at not exceeding 50 years as on 18.11.2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NAM Wayanad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check that you meet the qualification and age criteria for your post in the notice. Apply online through the website https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in. Enter your details clearly in the application. Incomplete applications will be rejected without any consideration. Make sure the details you enter match your original documents, because these will be checked at the interview. Submit the online application on or before 30 November 2026 (on or before 03 December 2026 for Yoga Instructor). Applications sent by email will not be accepted. Documents named in the notice: Original documents, to be produced at the interview Equivalency certificate, for applicants with an equivalent qualification

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice states that the selection process may include a Skill Test / written examination and an interview, as required. It does not give the date, venue or pattern of any of these stages. If the details in an application do not match the original documents produced at the interview, the application will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NAM Wayanad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 30 November 2026. For Yoga Instructor, the revised notification dated 21.11.2026 sets the last date as 03 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are included in NAM Wayanad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The 11 posts are Pharmacist (Ayurveda), Therapist (Ayurveda), Lab Technician, Physiotherapist, Psychologist, Clinical Psychologist, Occupational Therapist, Special Educator, Multipurpose Worker, Yoga Instructor and Multipurpose Health Worker.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for NAM Wayanad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For all posts except Yoga Instructor, the age must not exceed 40 years as on 18.11.2026. For Yoga Instructor, the age must not exceed 50 years as on 18.11.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for NAM Wayanad posts?
faq.answer: The salary is 14700/- for Pharmacist (Ayurveda), Therapist (Ayurveda) and Lab Technician; 21000/- for Physiotherapist; 30000/- for Psychologist, Clinical Psychologist, Occupational Therapist and Special Educator; 13500/- for Multipurpose Worker; 14000/- for Yoga Instructor; and 15000/- for Multipurpose Health Worker.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for the Multipurpose Worker post?
faq.answer: The qualification for Multipurpose Worker is Plus Two with Computer Knowledge.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NAM Wayanad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in by 30 November 2026 (03 December 2026 for Yoga Instructor). Incomplete applications will be rejected without any consideration.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection may include a Skill Test / written examination and an interview, as required.

faq.question: Q8. Can I send my application by email?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that applications sent by email will not be accepted. Applications must be submitted online.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. The appointments are temporary and made on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. What should candidates with an equivalent qualification submit?
faq.answer: Candidates with an equivalent qualification must produce an equivalency certificate.
